evidence: decorative_mascot: Data holds the same forward-lean/slide pose hovering in the gap right of the 1972 bar in hook@0.3, seg0:mid, seg1:mid, seg2:start, seg3:mid and seg4:mid — he never touches, pushes, measures or reacts to a bar, so there is no setup->action->payoff tied to any stat.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: hook@0.3 to seg0:end is a slow build of five nearly empty grey bars titled 'Population ages 65 and above' with the stale annotation '1972 PULLS AHEAD'; at t=0.3s only stubs of purple exist and the mascot sits inert behind the caption, and this exact layout then repeats unchanged for seg1 (seg1:start), seg2 (seg2:start), seg3 (seg3:start) and seg4 — three unrelated metrics rendered as one identical template for 96s.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene plan assigns the generic bar-race renderer to every segment with no per-scene visual concept, and the opening beat starts from zero-length bars, so the first two seconds are a chart loading rather than an event; the '1972 PULLS AHEAD' label is a hard-coded leader caption that is meaningless for a rising series.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Open seg0 cold on an already-loaded state with a visible physical demonstration of the ageing share (e.g. a filling column of people/blocks that visibly overflows between 1972 and 2025) and give Data a bit that acts on it — he plants at the 1972 bar and gets shoved back as it grows — so the first 2s contain an action, and differentiate seg0's treatment from the bar-race used in seg1/seg2.
